Trace, implement and test: Given an array, find the number of sub-arrays whose sum is odd.

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
# Given an array, find the number of sub-arrays whose sum is odd.

# Input Format

# First line contains the size of the array.
# second line the list of elements, separated by space
# Output Format:

# print the number of sub arrays who sum is odd
# Example Input

# 5 4 4 5 1 3

# Output

# 12

n,array = int(input()),list(map(int,input().split()))
subArray = [array[i:j] for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1,n+1)]
print(subArray)
# print('Len:',len(subArray))

result = list(filter(lambda x:sum(x)%2 !=0,subArray))
print(len(result))
